$comment: Fact ledger: every phone number, dollar figure, deadline and program-status claim this skill states with an external source, verified on that source, with the date and the files that carry it. scripts/check-facts.mjs fails CI when a fact is past its recheck date, a listed file is missing, or the value (or each string in match) no longer appears in its listed files. Recheck intervals: phone numbers 180 days; dollar figures and program status 90; annual-cycle figures use recheck_on with the next cycle's date. Only add an entry you verified on its source that day; never back-date. The credit-economics figures in skill/SKILL.md ($0.15/credit, 70% expert share, cost per credit) are this product's own design parameters, not externally sourced facts, so they are not ledger entries.
